name: Interdimensional shackles
slug: Restraints Haldor hoped to use on the spirit problem, which Gerk does not have.
description: Interdimensional shackles are restraints Haldor hoped could be used on the spirit problem. Gerk was not carrying them, and nothing further is known about where a set is or how the shackles work.

log.summary: Haldor asked whether Gerk had the interdimensional shackles, hoping to use them on the spirit problem. Gerk did not. Haldor refused Gerk's offer to open a doorway to a set of shackles inside the city.
notes: Haldor asks whether Gerk has them and hoped to use them on the spirit problem. Gerk does not. Haldor refuses Gerk's offer to open a doorway to a set of shackles inside the city.
